properties.name: camel.mcp-server.allowed-origins
properties.description: Comma-separated list of origins allowed to call the Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint. Entries may be exact origins or use a wildcard port, for example http://localhost:*. When unset, only loopback origins are allowed. Requests without an Origin header are accepted. This setting is applied when Camel's Streamable HTTP transport provider is selected.

properties.name: camel.mcp-server.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable Camel MCP integration for ai-tool, ai-resource, and ai-prompt routes through the Spring AI MCP server. Enabled by default when the starter is on the classpath.

properties.name: camel.mcp-server.prompt-timeout
properties.description: Per-request prompt execution timeout in milliseconds. A request exceeding the timeout returns an error to the MCP client; the underlying route may continue running until it completes.

properties.name: camel.mcp-server.resource-timeout
properties.description: Per-read resource execution timeout in milliseconds. A read exceeding the timeout returns an error to the MCP client; the underlying route keeps running until it completes on its own.

properties.name: camel.mcp-server.tags
properties.description: Comma-separated tag patterns used to select ai-tool, ai-resource, and ai-prompt routes for MCP exposure. Only matching routes are published; the untagged default pools are never exposed. When not set, no Camel tools, resources, resource templates, or prompts are published.

properties.name: camel.mcp-server.tool-timeout
properties.description: Per-call tool execution timeout in milliseconds. A call exceeding the timeout returns an error result to the MCP client; the underlying route keeps running until it completes on its own. The default is 20000 milliseconds.

properties.name: camel.mcp-server.transport-enabled
properties.description: Whether to replace Spring AI's default Streamable HTTP transport with Camel's transport. When unset, replacement is enabled only when {@code tags} is configured. Set this to true to enable Camel Origin validation and caller-context extraction without Camel routes, or false to keep Spring AI's provider while leaving the Camel bridge independently enabled.
